newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moody's assigns ratings to Daegu Bank.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns ratings to Daegu Bank.

text.p: Moody's Investors Services said on Thursday it had assigned the following first-time ratings to South Korea's Daegu Bank Ltd -

Moody's said the ratings reflect Daegu Bank's strong market presence in its region, its consistently sound financial performance and said the bank was likely to receive support from regulators if needed.

The bank, South Korea's regional bank, specialises in lending to local small and medium size companies and avoided the large securities losses experienced by most other South Korean financial institions in 1995 and 1996 by maintaining a small exposure to equities.

Capital ratios are healthy -- it reported a strong risk-weighted Tier One capital ratio of 11.39 percent, a Total capital ratio of 12.88 percent and total consolidated assets of 12,152 billion won at the end of 1995.
